vetSays.line: 🛡️ Teresa, Luis, the woman in her 30s, with a wiry build and Nora met them at the door — 4 put down. Teresa, Luis, the woman in her 30s, with a wiry build, Nora are hurt.
🛡️ Luis and Rosa met them at the door — 2 put down. Luis, Rosa are hurt.
🛡️ Avery, Silas, Teresa, Priya and Nora met them at the door — 5 put down. Avery, Silas, Teresa, Priya, Nora are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Static falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Static!
📺 You brought down Scarred Static. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
You catch Aroha telling the fire about Luis. "You brought down Scarred Static." The story's already growing.
🛡️ Teresa, Luis, Priya, Chloe and Rosa met them at the door — 5 put down. Teresa, Luis, Priya, Chloe, Rosa are hurt.
🛡️ Avery, Silas, Teresa, Nora and Rosa met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Teresa didn't come back. Avery, Silas, Nora, Rosa are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luis just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Priya just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Silas, Luis, Priya, Nora and Rosa met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Silas, Luis, Priya, Nora, Rosa are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
The Scarred The Loud Thing wears Teresa's face. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track you — they don't track anything.
Priya SCREAMS — a sound like milk curdling in fast-forward. The Scarred The Loud Thing freezes. (stunned)
The Scarred The Loud Thing is still frozen from your scream.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.

regDeaths.name: stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
the absence of sound, shaped like wings
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
a soft green glow under the water
a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
a soft green glow under the water
